title: OmniSpectra: A Unified Foundation Model for Universal Spectra Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2601.15351v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Standard sequence models encode position by token rank rather than physical coordinate, typically forcing practitioners to destructively resample continuous physical signals such as spectra observed across heterogeneous instruments. We identify this coordinate mismatch as a structural limitation in cross-instrument representation learning, and propose OmniSpectra, a wavelength-native foundation model for spectral representation learning: a continuous-coordinate masked autoencoder that discards the integer pixel indexing of sequence modeling. Mapping physical coordinates to a logarithmic basis turns the multiplicative scaling induced by cosmological redshift into a uniform additive shift. In continuous rotary position embeddings, this shared shift cancels from relative token distances rather than producing grid-dependent positional distortion. translated_title: OmniSpectra：面向通用光谱表示学习的统一基础模型
translated_abstract: 标准序列模型通过词元序号而非物理坐标来编码位置，这通常迫使研究人员对连续物理信号（例如在不同异构仪器上观测到的光谱）进行破坏性重采样。我们将这种坐标失配确定为跨仪器表示学习中的一个结构性局限，并提出 OmniSpectra——一个以波长为本的光谱表示学习基础模型：一种连续坐标掩码自编码器，摒弃了序列建模中的整数像素索引。将物理坐标映射到对数基上，可将宇宙学红移引起的乘性缩放转化为统一的加性平移。在连续旋转位置嵌入中，这一共享平移会从相对词元距离中抵消，而不会产生依赖网格的位置畸变。我们进一步利用一种物理……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: OmniSpectra 提出一种以波长为原生坐标的连续坐标掩码自编码器基础模型，通过将对数基上的物理坐标与连续旋转位置编码结合，使宇宙学红移引发的共享平移在相对距离中自然抵消，从而解决了跨异构仪器光谱表示学习中的坐标失配这一结构性难题。
en_tdlr: OmniSpectra is a wavelength-native foundation model using a continuous-coordinate masked autoencoder that maps physical coordinates onto a logarithmic basis, turning cosmological redshift into a shared additive shift that cancels in continuous rotary position embeddings, thereby overcoming the coordinate mismatch limiting cross-instrument spectra representation learning.
